summary.name: Linearity
summary.one_liner: Linearity is an AI design generator that turns a text prompt into a set of editable, brand-consistent campaign assets such as posts, ads, emails and slides.
use_cases: generate social media posts from a prompt
create launch ads and campaign visuals
resize designs for multiple social platforms
localize campaign assets for regional markets
maintain brand consistency across team designs
summary.what_it_does: Linearity generates a complete campaign design (posts, ads, emails, slides) from a plain-language prompt and a brand kit. The output is a layered, editable file rather than a flat image, so headlines, logos, colors and layout can be changed afterward. It includes auto-resize for adapting designs to different social formats and localization for markets. Teams can use shared workspaces, locked templates and role permissions with approval workflows. Exports are available in PNG, JPEG, SVG, PDF and Linearity document formats.
notable: Outputs layered, fully editable vector files instead of flat images
Brand kit import for logos, colors, fonts and templates
Team roles, locked templates and approval workflows
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the 'Pay for speed' section refers to plans without details
